Amortization vs Depreciation: Key Differences Many people confuse amortization vs depreciation. Here's a quick breakdown: - Amortization applies to intangible assets like goodwill, patents, and trademarks. - Depreciation applies to tangible assets like machinery, buildings, and vehicles. Amortization Methods in Accounting There are different amortization methods used based on the nature of the asset and business requirements. 1. Straight Line Amortization Straight line amortization is the simplest and most widely used method. It spreads the cost equally over the asset's useful life. Straight line amortization formula: Amortization Expense = (Initial Cost - Residual Value) / Useful Life This method ensures consistency and makes financial reporting straightforward and predictable. 2.
